body:
Built the real login -> matchmaking queue -> HMAC connect-ticket -> UDP connect flow for WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS, direct port of GoblinFoxDragon/apps2/battlegrounds_gui's own proven login-screen pattern plus IDUNA's own SHANKPIT ticket/queue infrastructure (RacerTicketHandler, a second ShankpitQueue instance at /api/v1/racer/queue/*). Verified live end-to-end this session (throwaway local IDUNA+server pair, real test@test.com/testtest account): login -> queue matched instantly (MinPlayers=1, bots fill the rest of the match) -> ticket minted -> real HMAC-verified UDP CONNECT -> WELCOME -> server-authoritative vehicle sim ticking. Found and fixed a real bug live: the matchmaking poll loop only noticed a queuing->matched TRANSITION, so an instant-matched join left the player stuck forever -- fixed by checking the join response's own state directly. Server now fails closed on ticket verification (was previously anonymous-connect). hud_text.h stroke font is an explicit, documented placeholder pending real PARENA/LINNEN font integration, per the founder's own same-session direction. IDUNA commits 4b93e6e/85f7b3d. WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS commits 956743c/0ed2244. Deploy queued: sudo-queue/33-restart-iduna-and-racer-server-for-login.sh.

⚓ ☃
title: Real IDUNA login for BEDROCK_RACERS, ported from GFD, verified with test@test.com
